verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֛י רֹ֥דְפֵי צֶ֖דֶק מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אֶל־ צ֣וּר חֻצַּבְתֶּ֔ם וְאֶל־ מַקֶּ֥בֶת בּ֖וֹר נֻקַּרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’ê·lay rō·ḏə·p̄ê ṣe·ḏeq mə·ḇaq·šê Yah·weh hab·bî·ṭū ’el- ṣūr ḥuṣ·ṣaḇ·tem wə·’el- maq·qe·ḇeṯ bō·wr nuq·qar·tem
verses.literal: Listen to Me you who pursue righteousness you who seek the LORD Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry . . . from which you were hewn
verses.literalPt: Escutai-me, vós os que seguis a justiça, que buscais a Jeová; olhai para a rocha de que fostes cortados e para a caverna do poço de que fostes cavados.

verses.original: הַבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אֲבִיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־ שָׂרָ֖ה תְּחוֹלֶלְכֶ֑ם כִּי־ אֶחָ֣ד קְרָאתִ֔יו וַאֲבָרְכֵ֖הוּ וְאַרְבֵּֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hab·bî·ṭū ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·ḇî·ḵem wə·’el- śā·rāh tə·ḥō·w·lel·ḵem kî- ’e·ḥāḏ qə·rā·ṯîw wa·’ă·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū wə·’ar·bê·hū
verses.literal: Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who gave you birth When I called him he was but one then I blessed him and multiplied him
verses.literalPt: Olhai para Abraão, vosso pai e para Sara, que vos deu à luz; porque, estando ele só, o chamei, e o abençoei, e o multipliquei.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֜ה צִיּ֗וֹן נִחַם֙ כָּל־ חָרְבֹתֶ֔יהָ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם מִדְבָּרָהּ֙ כְּעֵ֔דֶן וְעַרְבָתָ֖הּ כְּגַן־ יְהוָ֑ה שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא בָ֔הּ תּוֹדָ֖ה וְק֥וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ni·ḥam Yah·weh ṣî·yō·wn ni·ḥam kāl- ḥā·rə·ḇō·ṯe·hā way·yā·śem miḏ·bā·rāh kə·‘ê·ḏen wə·‘ar·ḇā·ṯāh kə·ḡan- Yah·weh śā·śō·wn wə·śim·ḥāh yim·mā·ṣê ḇāh tō·w·ḏāh wə·qō·wl zim·rāh
verses.literal: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD Joy and gladness will be found in her thanksgiving and melodious song
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová conforta a Sião, conforta todos os lugares desolados e faz o seu deserto como o Éden e o seu ermo, como o jardim de Jeová; nela, se achará gozo e alegria, ação de graças e som de música.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבוּ אֵלַי֙ עַמִּ֔י וּלְאוּמִּ֖י אֵלַ֣י הַאֲזִ֑ינוּ כִּ֤י תוֹרָה֙ מֵאִתִּ֣י תֵצֵ֔א וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֔י לְא֥וֹר עַמִּ֖ים אַרְגִּֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šî·ḇū ’ê·lay ‘am·mî ū·lə·’ūm·mî ’ê·lay ha·’ă·zî·nū kî ṯō·w·rāh mê·’it·tî ṯê·ṣê ū·miš·pā·ṭî lə·’ō·wr ‘am·mîm ’ar·gî·a‘
verses.literal: Pay attention to Me My people and listen to Me My nation for a law . . . will go out from Me and My justice will become a light to the nations I will bring it about quickly
verses.literalPt: Atendei-me, povo meu, e escutai-me, nação minha; porque de mim sairá a lei, e o meu juízo, estabelecê-lo-ei para a luz dos povos.

verses.original: קָר֤וֹב צִדְקִי֙ יָצָ֣א יִשְׁעִ֔י וּזְרֹעַ֖י עַמִּ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּ֑טוּ אֵלַי֙ אִיִּ֣ים יְקַוּ֔וּ וְאֶל־ זְרֹעִ֖י יְיַחֵלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rō·wḇ ṣiḏ·qî yā·ṣā yiš·‘î ū·zə·rō·‘ay ‘am·mîm yiš·pō·ṭū ’ê·lay ’î·yîm yə·qaw·wū wə·’el- zə·rō·‘î yə·ya·ḥê·lūn
verses.literal: My righteousness draws near My salvation is on the way and My arms will bring justice to the nations The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm
verses.literalPt: Perto está a minha justiça, já saiu a minha salvação, e os meus braços julgarão os povos; as ilhas me aguardarão, e no meu braço confiarão.

verses.original: שְׂאוּ֩ לַשָּׁמַ֨יִם עֵֽינֵיכֶ֜ם וְֽהַבִּ֧יטוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ מִתַּ֗חַת כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֜יִם כֶּעָשָׁ֤ן נִמְלָ֙חוּ֙ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ כַּבֶּ֣גֶד תִּבְלֶ֔ה וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כְּמוֹ־ כֵ֣ן יְמוּת֑וּן וִישֽׁוּעָתִי֙ לְעוֹלָ֣ם תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְצִדְקָתִ֖י לֹ֥א תֵחָֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū laš·šā·ma·yim ‘ê·nê·ḵem wə·hab·bî·ṭū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ mit·ta·ḥaṯ kî- šā·ma·yim ke·‘ā·šān nim·lā·ḥū wə·hā·’ā·reṣ kab·be·ḡeḏ tiḇ·leh wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā kə·mōw- ḵên yə·mū·ṯūn wî·šū·‘ā·ṯî lə·‘ō·w·lām tih·yeh wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî lō ṯê·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: Lift up your eyes to the heavens and look at the earth below for the heavens will vanish like smoke the earth will wear out like a garment and its people will die like gnats . . . But My salvation will last forever . . . and My righteousness will never fail
verses.literalPt: Levantai os vossos olhos para os céus, e olhai para a terra cá embaixo, porque os céus desaparecerão como o fumo e a terra envelhecerá como um vestido, e os seus moradores perecerão da mesma maneira; a minha salvação, porém, será para sempre, e a minha justiça não será abolida.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ יֹ֣דְעֵי צֶ֔דֶק עַ֖ם תּוֹרָתִ֣י בְלִבָּ֑ם אַל־ תִּֽירְאוּ֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת אֱנ֔וֹשׁ וּמִגִּדֻּפֹתָ֖ם אַל־ תֵּחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’ê·lay yō·ḏə·‘ê ṣe·ḏeq ‘am tō·w·rā·ṯî ḇə·lib·bām ’al- tî·rə·’ū ḥer·paṯ ’ĕ·nō·wōš ū·mig·gid·du·p̄ō·ṯām ’al- tê·ḥāt·tū
verses.literal: Listen to Me you who know what is right you people with My law in your hearts Do not fear the scorn of men do not be broken by their insults
verses.literalPt: Escutai-me, vós os que seguis a justiça, povo em cujo coração está a minha lei; não temais o opróbrio dos homens, nem vos perturbeis por causa dos seus vilipêndios.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כַבֶּ֙גֶד֙ יֹאכְלֵ֣ם עָ֔שׁ וְכַצֶּ֖מֶר יֹאכְלֵ֣ם סָ֑ס וְצִדְקָתִי֙ לְעוֹלָ֣ם תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וִישׁוּעָתִ֖י לְד֥וֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵab·be·ḡeḏ yō·ḵə·lêm ‘āš wə·ḵaṣ·ṣe·mer yō·ḵə·lêm sās wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî lə·‘ō·w·lām tih·yeh wî·šū·‘ā·ṯî lə·ḏō·wr dō·w·rîm
verses.literal: For the moth will devour them like a garment and the worm will eat them like wool But My righteousness will last forever . . . My salvation through all generations . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois a traça os consumirá como a um vestido, e o bicho os comerá como à lã; a minha justiça, porém, será para sempre, e a minha salvação, de geração em geração.

verses.original: עוּרִ֨י עוּרִ֤י לִבְשִׁי־ עֹז֙ זְר֣וֹעַ יְהוָ֔ה ע֚וּרִי כִּ֣ימֵי קֶ֔דֶם דֹּר֖וֹת עוֹלָמִ֑ים הֲל֥וֹא אַתְּ־ הִ֛יא הַמַּחְצֶ֥בֶת רַ֖הַב מְחוֹלֶ֥לֶת תַּנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·rî ‘ū·rî liḇ·šî- ‘ōz zə·rō·w·a‘ Yah·weh ‘ū·rî kî·mê qe·ḏem dō·rō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lā·mîm hă·lō·w ’at- hî ham·maḥ·ṣe·ḇeṯ ra·haḇ mə·ḥō·w·le·leṯ tan·nîn
verses.literal: Awake awake put on strength O arm of the LORD Wake up as in days past as in generations of old Was it not . . . You who cut Rahab to pieces who pierced through the dragon
verses.literalPt: Desperta-te, desperta-te, veste-te de fortaleza, ó braço de Jeová; desperta-te como nos dias da antiguidade, nas gerações dos tempos antigos. Porventura, não és tu o que cortou em pedaços a Raabe, aquele que traspassou ao dragão?

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא אַתְּ־ הִיא֙ הַמַּחֲרֶ֣בֶת יָ֔ם מֵ֖י תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה הַשָּׂ֙מָה֙ מַֽעֲמַקֵּי־ יָ֔ם דֶּ֖רֶךְ לַעֲבֹ֥ר גְּאוּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’at- hî ham·ma·ḥă·re·ḇeṯ yām mê tə·hō·wm rab·bāh haś·śā·māh ma·‘ă·maq·qê- yām de·reḵ la·‘ă·ḇōr gə·’ū·lîm
verses.literal: Was it not . . . You who dried up the sea the waters of the great deep who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over
verses.literalPt: Não és tu o que secou o mar, as águas do grande abismo; o que fez do fundo do mar um caminho, para que por ele passassem os remidos?

verses.original: וּפְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשׁוּב֗וּן וּבָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּרִנָּ֔ה וְשִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֑ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְשִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂיג֔וּן נָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַאֲנָחָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·ḏū·yê Yah·weh yə·šū·ḇūn ū·ḇā·’ū ṣî·yō·wn bə·rin·nāh wə·śim·ḥaṯ ‘ō·w·lām ‘al- rō·šām śā·śō·wn wə·śim·ḥāh yaś·śî·ḡūn nā·sū yā·ḡō·wn wa·’ă·nā·ḥāh
verses.literal: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing crowned . . . with everlasting joy Gladness and joy will overtake them and sorrow and sighing will flee
verses.literalPt: Os resgatados de Jeová voltarão e, com júbilo, virão para Sião; e alegria sempiterna descansará sobre as suas cabeças. Eles alcançarão gozo e alegria, e a tristeza e o gemido fugirão.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֧י אָנֹכִ֛י ה֖וּא מְנַחֶמְכֶ֑ם מִֽי־ אַ֤תְּ וַתִּֽירְאִי֙ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמ֔וּת וּמִבֶּן־ אָדָ֖ם חָצִ֥יר יִנָּתֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·nō·ḵî hū mə·na·ḥem·ḵem mî- ’at wat·tî·rə·’î mê·’ĕ·nō·wōš yā·mūṯ ū·mib·ben- ’ā·ḏām ḥā·ṣîr yin·nā·ṯên
verses.literal: I even I am He who comforts you Why should you be afraid of mortal man of a son of man who withers like grass
verses.literalPt: Eu, eu sou o que vos conforta; quem és tu, para teres medo de um homem, que morre, e do filho do homem, que se tornará como feno?

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁכַּ֞ח יְהוָ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֗ךָ נוֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַיִם֮ וְיֹסֵ֣ד אָרֶץ֒ וַתְּפַחֵ֨ד תָּמִ֜יד כָּל־ הַיּ֗וֹם מִפְּנֵי֙ חֲמַ֣ת הַמֵּצִ֔יק כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר כּוֹנֵ֖ן לְהַשְׁחִ֑ית וְאַיֵּ֖ה חֲמַ֥ת הַמֵּצִֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·kaḥ Yah·weh ‘ō·śe·ḵā nō·w·ṭeh šā·ma·yim wə·yō·sêḏ ’ā·reṣ wat·tə·p̄a·ḥêḏ tā·mîḏ kāl- hay·yō·wm mip·pə·nê ḥă·maṯ ham·mê·ṣîq ka·’ă·šer kō·w·nên lə·haš·ḥîṯ wə·’ay·yêh ḥă·maṯ ham·mê·ṣîq
verses.literal: But you have forgotten the LORD your Maker who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth You live in terror all day long . . . because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction But where is the fury of the oppressor
verses.literalPt: Quem és tu que te esqueces de Jeová, teu Criador, o qual estendeu os céus e fundou a terra; e que o dia todo temes continuamente por causa do furor do opressor, quando se prepara para destruir? Onde está o furor do opressor?

verses.original: מִהַ֥ר צֹעֶ֖ה לְהִפָּתֵ֑חַ וְלֹא־ יָמ֣וּת לַשַּׁ֔חַת וְלֹ֥א יֶחְסַ֖ר לַחְמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mi·har ṣō·‘eh lə·hip·pā·ṯê·aḥ wə·lō- yā·mūṯ laš·ša·ḥaṯ wə·lō yeḥ·sar laḥ·mōw
verses.literal: The captive will soon be freed he will not die in the dungeon and his bread will not be lacking
verses.literalPt: O exilado cativo depressa será solto e não morrerá para ir à sepultura, nem lhe faltará o pão.

verses.original: וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ רֹגַ֣ע הַיָּ֔ם וַיֶּהֱמ֖וּ גַּלָּ֑יו יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā rō·ḡa‘ hay·yām way·ye·hĕ·mū gal·lāw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar the LORD of Hosts is His name
verses.literalPt: Pois eu sou Jeová, teu Deus, que agito o mar, de modo que bramem as suas ondas; Jeová dos Exércitos é o seu nome.

verses.original: וָאָשִׂ֤ים דְּבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יךָ וּבְצֵ֥ל יָדִ֖י כִּסִּיתִ֑יךָ לִנְטֹ֤עַ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלִיסֹ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְלֵאמֹ֥ר לְצִיּ֖וֹן עַמִּי־ אָֽתָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·śîm də·ḇā·ray bə·p̄î·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṣêl yā·ḏî kis·sî·ṯî·ḵā lin·ṭō·a‘ šā·ma·yim wə·lî·sōḏ ’ā·reṣ wə·lê·mōr lə·ṣî·yō·wn ‘am·mî- ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: I have put My words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of My hand to establish the heavens to found the earth and to say to Zion You are My people
verses.literalPt: Pus as minhas palavras na tua boca e, na sombra da minha mão, te escondi, para que eu plante os céus, funde a terra e diga a Sião: Tu és o meu povo.

verses.original: הִתְעוֹרְרִ֣י הִֽתְעוֹרְרִ֗י ק֚וּמִי יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁתִ֛ית מִיַּ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ כּ֣וֹס חֲמָת֑וֹ אֶת־ קֻבַּ֜עַת כּ֧וֹס הַתַּרְעֵלָ֛ה שָׁתִ֖ית מָצִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·‘ō·wr·rî hiṯ·‘ō·wr·rî qū·mî yə·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer šā·ṯîṯ mî·yaḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- kō·ws ḥă·mā·ṯōw ’eṯ- qub·ba·‘aṯ kō·ws hat·tar·‘ê·lāh šā·ṯîṯ mā·ṣîṯ
verses.literal: Awake awake Rise up O Jerusalem you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His fury you who have drained the goblet to the dregs the cup that makes men stagger
verses.literalPt: Desperta-te, desperta-te, põe-te de pé, Jerusalém, que bebeste da mão de Jeová o cálice do seu furor, que bebeste da taça de atordoamento e a esgotaste.

verses.original: אֵין־ מְנַהֵ֣ל לָ֔הּ מִכָּל־ בָּנִ֖ים יָלָ֑דָה וְאֵ֤ין מַחֲזִיק֙ בְּיָדָ֔הּ מִכָּל־ בָּנִ֖ים גִּדֵּֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- mə·na·hêl lāh mik·kāl bā·nîm yā·lā·ḏāh wə·’ên ma·ḥă·zîq bə·yā·ḏāh mik·kāl bā·nîm gid·dê·lāh
verses.literal: Among all the sons she bore there is no one to guide her among all the sons she brought up there is no one to take her hand
verses.literalPt: De todos os filhos que ela teve, não há nenhum que a guie; e, de todos os filhos que ela criou, não há nenhum que a tome pela mão.

verses.original: שְׁתַּ֤יִם הֵ֙נָּה֙ קֹֽרְאֹתַ֔יִךְ מִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑ךְ הַשֹּׁ֧ד וְהַשֶּׁ֛בֶר וְהָרָעָ֥ב וְהַחֶ֖רֶב מִ֥י אֲנַחֲמֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ta·yim hên·nāh qō·rə·’ō·ṯa·yiḵ mî yā·nūḏ lāḵ haš·šōḏ wə·haš·še·ḇer wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ wə·ha·ḥe·reḇ mî ’ă·na·ḥă·mêḵ
verses.literal: These pairs have befallen you devastation and destruction famine and sword Who will grieve for you Who can comfort you
verses.literalPt: Essas duas coisas te sobrevieram; quem se condoerá de ti? A desolação e a destruição, a fome e a espada! Como te consolarei?

verses.original: בָּנַ֜יִךְ עֻלְּפ֥וּ שָׁכְב֛וּ בְּרֹ֥אשׁ כָּל־ חוּצ֖וֹת כְּת֣וֹא מִכְמָ֑ר הַֽמְלֵאִ֥ים חֲמַת־ יְהוָ֖ה גַּעֲרַ֥ת אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·na·yiḵ ‘ul·lə·p̄ū šā·ḵə·ḇū bə·rōš kāl- ḥū·ṣō·wṯ kə·ṯō·w miḵ·mār ham·lê·’îm ḥă·maṯ- Yah·weh ga·‘ă·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Your sons have fainted they lie at the head of every street like an antelope in a net They are full of the wrath of the LORD the rebuke of your God
verses.literalPt: Teus filhos já desmaiaram, jazem nas esquinas de todas as ruas, como um antílope tomado no laço; cheios estão do furor de Jeová, da repreensão de teu Deus.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן שִׁמְעִי־ נָ֥א זֹ֖את עֲנִיָּ֑ה וּשְׁכֻרַ֖ת וְלֹ֥א מִיָּֽיִן׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘î- nā zōṯ ‘ă·nî·yāh ū·šə·ḵu·raṯ wə·lō mî·yā·yin
verses.literal: Therefore now hear this you afflicted one drunken but not with wine
verses.literalPt: Agora, ouve isto, ó tu que estás aflita e embriagada, porém não de vinho.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנַ֣יִךְ יְהוָ֗ה וֵאלֹהַ֙יִךְ֙ יָרִ֣יב עַמּ֔וֹ הִנֵּ֥ה לָקַ֛חְתִּי מִיָּדֵ֖ךְ אֶת־ כּ֣וֹס הַתַּרְעֵלָ֑ה אֶת־ קֻבַּ֙עַת֙ כּ֣וֹס חֲמָתִ֔י לֹא־ תוֹסִ֥יפִי לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·na·yiḵ Yah·weh wê·lō·ha·yiḵ yā·rîḇ ‘am·mōw hin·nêh lā·qaḥ·tî mî·yā·ḏêḵ ’eṯ- kō·ws hat·tar·‘ê·lāh ’eṯ- qub·ba·‘aṯ kō·ws ḥă·mā·ṯî lō- ṯō·w·sî·p̄î liš·tō·w·ṯāh ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Thus says your Lord the LORD even your God who defends His people See I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering From that goblet the cup of My fury you will never drink again . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o teu Senhor Jeová e teu Deus, que pleiteia a causa do teu povo: Eis que tiro da tua mão o cálice de atordoamento, a taça do meu furor; tu não o tornarás mais a beber,

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֙יהָ֙ בְּיַד־ מוֹגַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־ אָמְר֥וּ לְנַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ שְׁחִ֣י וְנַעֲבֹ֑רָה וַתָּשִׂ֤ימִי כָאָ֙רֶץ֙ גֵּוֵ֔ךְ וְכַח֖וּץ לַעֹבְרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî·hā bə·yaḏ- mō·w·ḡa·yiḵ ’ă·šer- ’ā·mə·rū lə·nap̄·šêḵ šə·ḥî wə·na·‘ă·ḇō·rāh wat·tā·śî·mî ḵā·’ā·reṣ gê·wêḵ wə·ḵa·ḥūṣ la·‘ō·ḇə·rîm
verses.literal: I will place it in the hands of your tormentors who told you Lie down so we can walk over you so that you made your back like the ground like a street to be traversed
verses.literalPt: mas eu o porei nas mãos dos que te afligem, os quais diziam à tua alma: Abaixa-te, para que passemos. Tu punhas as tuas costas como o chão e como a rua para os que passavam.
